claim: Standard-code logical feasibility has an explicit linear-size 2-CNF encoding.
support: All 20 standard sense-code relations and six allowed pair types are represented without auxiliary bits; the established implication-graph algorithm supplies tractability.
strongest_challenge: Generic 2-SAT feasibility is prior work; Boolean bit moves are not automatically nucleotide substitutions.
remaining_limitation: The result concerns declared logical constraints, not realizability or energetic stability of an RNA ensemble.
decision: Retain the explicit code-specific representation and withhold a new generic 2-SAT claim.

claim: Single-frame component signatures are complete and connected endpoint distance is nucleotide Hamming distance.
support: Purine/pyrimidine orientations, serine families and the stated partial-codon rules determine components. Endpoint orders form ideals of event posets of height at most three; matchings give disjoint chains.
strongest_challenge: Generic binary-CSP geodesicity is known, while partial Leu/Arg gates and two-bit nucleotide changes require the code-specific lifting argument.
remaining_limitation: Extra motif, score or overlapping-frame constraints can invalidate the original signature. Finite checks corroborate the proof.
decision: Retain with the single-frame and logical-obligation assumptions explicit.

claim: Overlapping standard-code obligations admit an exact quotient with Cartesian fibres and nucleotide geodesics.
support: The at-most-n-bit quotient uses implication strongly connected component invariants. The amended API includes complete unsatisfiability detection and a compact coordinate-move witness.
strongest_challenge: Coarse orientation and serine signatures alone are insufficient; larger coordinate domains and complemented gates must preserve the quotient predicates.
remaining_limitation: Arbitrary ordered logical triplets are more general than physical reading frames. The single-frame height-three bound does not extend to arbitrary overlaps.
decision: Retain the stronger signature and distinguish compact witness cost from full sequence materialization.

claim: Uniform completion counts have a conditional leucine factor two; route counting can be hard despite simple reachability.
support: Elimination of unpaired coordinates gives the weighted independent-set representation. The codon reduction realizes restricted-poset precedences; forest dependency counting has an explicit arithmetic-cost bound.
strongest_challenge: Independent-set inference, order polytopes and restricted linear-extension hardness are established. Reduction conventions cannot be strengthened silently.
remaining_limitation: Leucine factor two is conditional and need not survive arbitrary codon weights. #P-completeness uses polynomial-time Turing reductions and an input-dependent number of logical targets, not exactly two physical structures.
decision: Retain the precise specialization, separate arithmetic from bit cost, and do not assert broader physical-structure hardness.

claim: Declared register geometries have phase-specific product classes and certified conditional scarcity rates.
support: Exact transfer polynomials and integer-vector spectral certificates support the standard-code phase and endpoint-distance statements under the specified arm-peptide model.
strongest_challenge: Fibonacci counts and transfer matrices are known; the increment is the code-specific register language and rates.
remaining_limitation: No qualifying observed native coding register switch was recovered. Conditional uniform-peptide scarcity is not a universal native-gene or energetic law.
decision: Retain as restricted-model mathematics, not an explanation of an observed biological switch.

claim: The additive independent-set criterion identifies exactly when all nonempty superlevel graphs are connected.
support: The positive-gain induced subgraph being edgeless is the stated criterion; compatibility conflicts can create barriers even for an additive score.
strongest_challenge: Independent-set geometry and additive decomposition are established; accurately predicting the coefficients is a separate problem.
remaining_limitation: The theorem does not establish folding-specific interactions, occupancy change or functional rescue.
decision: Retain as a conditional geometric criterion and do not infer score predictability from it.

claim: Exact barrier ranges on rational affine polytopes are computable at fixed latent dimension; route quantifiers coincide universally exactly for a unique minimal connecting vertex set.
support: Reviewed proofs cover nonempty bounded rational polytopes, lower-dimensional cases and ties; variable-dimension possible and guaranteed threshold decisions have NP-complete and coNP-complete boundaries. Independent exact oracles agree on 82 cases and 400 rational quantities, with a separate finite route-quantifier corpus.
strongest_challenge: Lattice-polynomial and arrangement machinery are established. Generic box corners fail, and a unique minimal connecting vertex set is not a unique simple path.
remaining_limitation: Fixed dimension has a dimension-dependent exponent. Deterministic uncertainty sets are not calibrated confidence regions. Priority for specific reductions remains unverified.
decision: Retain the explicit specialized statements, independent verification and limitations; withhold first-algorithm and biological calibration claims.

claim: Factor-level additive-product closure supports exact endpoint connectivity, capacity and constructive witnesses.
support: Canonical reachable anchors and first-exit containment establish the closure query. Baseline factor connectivity is checked before rational threshold search; numerical and witness costs are stated separately.
strongest_challenge: Additive merge-tree composition is established, and the closest detailed thesis construction was not fully accessible.
remaining_limitation: No first or fastest algorithm claim. A component is not the retained part of its projection product. Witnesses need not be shortest; exact capacity is polynomial in bit complexity, not asserted strongly polynomial.
decision: Retain the explicit query and verified bounds while marking algorithmic priority unresolved.

claim: Generic score organization accounts for most of the original permutation contrast; the residual is not a demonstrated folding mechanism.
support: Across 404 spaces and 185 transcript clusters, heat-reference matching attenuates 94.06% in cell and 94.93% cell free. Remaining mean integral contrasts are 0.005612 and 0.004395. Codon-additive contrasts are -0.001222 and -0.001157, so fitted additive fields are slightly less fragmented.
strongest_challenge: Imperfect roughness matching, influential transcripts, model/context choice, ties and saturated fits can affect residual interpretation.
remaining_limitation: Retrospective influence, tighter matching, unsaturated fits and tie checks retain the descriptive pattern but do not identify a mechanism. Additive fits are in sample; cluster intervals describe this modeled transcript collection, not biological-replicate uncertainty.
decision: Withdraw an established RNA-specific preservation or evolutionary-advantage claim; retain the control result and bounded residual.

status: Failed frozen computational pilot; design uninformative for mechanism
claim: The original three-state barrier/intervention pilot did not pass its expansion criteria.
support: All 24 scaffolds, 72 landscapes and 48 interventions remain available. Five barriers met the declared threshold, none was predicted; direction prediction succeeded in 12 of 24 covered interventions. Lifetime error was worse than zero prediction.
strongest_challenge: Every three-state additive fit is saturated, so the design cannot distinguish additive from interacting fields.
remaining_limitation: This is synthetic folding-model evidence, not biological rescue or disruption. Unsupported intervention directions cannot be omitted.
decision: Preserve the failure and do not expand this motif into a folding-specific engineering result.

status: Failed frozen efficiency criterion; certificate checks passed
claim: Path/cut acquisition did not outperform the strongest included baseline.
support: All 3,800 worlds and 22,800 policy runs are retained. Mean excess over forward is 0.397632 queries; its approximate 95% seed-block interval is [0.260624, 0.534639]. All 213,220 checked prefixes gave zero false certificates.
strongest_challenge: Established forward querying is the strongest included comparator; lower observed maxima do not establish a better arbitrary-input worst case.
remaining_limitation: The interval covers Monte Carlo variation across 50 fixed-design seed blocks only. Forced-present endpoints are occupancy edits, not necessarily exact additive superlevel fields.
decision: Retain the audited certificate workflow and negative comparison; retire held-out seeds from tuning.

claim: The pairwise Gill predictor does not improve held-out RNA-library reproduction.
support: Complete K2 x K4 x K4 coverage gives 32 genotypes. Primary RMSE is 0.550617 versus 0.465695 for the constant baseline, an 18.2356% increase; the 10% improvement hurdle is 0.419126. Both pseudocount sensitivities also fail. All 672 model/pseudocount/genotype rows are retained.
strongest_challenge: The constant baseline outperforms the target; shared-reference shifts affect error, and the same genotypes occur in training and validation.
remaining_limitation: This is held-out RNA-library reproduction conditional on previously inspected DNA, not independent genotype, protein-context or biological validation.
decision: Keep the frozen failure without retuning or favorable-subset selection.

claim: Gill positive observed-field barriers do not establish biological nonadditivity or a folding mechanism.
support: All nine RNA/DNA scenarios have positive maximum barriers, ranging from 0.117434 to 0.447357 at pseudocount 0.5. The latter is the primary held-out field maximum; the maximizing endpoint pair may differ across fields.
strongest_challenge: Noise, reference anchoring and denominator changes can create apparent interactions and barriers; the nine fields reuse libraries.
remaining_limitation: Library identities are mapped, but independent biological preparations, RNA/DNA pairing and simultaneous error calibration remain unresolved. A range of fieldwise maxima is not a fixed-pair barrier interval or a confidence region.
decision: Report the measured contrasts and explicit dependence only; do not apply calibrated joint-uncertainty guarantees.

claim: The GFP/URA3 programme has sequence-verified candidate groups but no completed defensible interaction prediction result.
support: The audit records 6,470 condition-specific candidate squares. The corrected URA3 pilot stopped before fitting at S7 J11262, a positive fitness below the documented source cutoff. Planned validation doubles remain unexamined.
strongest_challenge: Shared mutants, normalized wild type and reporter dependence prevent treating candidate squares as independent observations; filtering and zero/subcutoff semantics remain inconsistent.
remaining_limitation: Complete-double replicate covariance and exact source-processing provenance are missing. The eligibility stop is not a rejected biological hypothesis or a predictive benchmark failure.
decision: Resolve measurement and processing semantics before further inference; retain the stopped executions.

claim: The frozen mitochondrial structure-to-function test could not meet its transcript coverage gate.
support: Only 6 of 11 units passed the 30-nt structural feature gate against a minimum of 9. Sensitivities gave 6 at 15 nt and 7 at 45 nt. Functional outcomes remain unexamined and no model was fitted.
strongest_challenge: At most eleven transcript/bicistronic units are independent; cross-study structural and functional measurements lack established same-aliquot and exact condition matching.
remaining_limitation: Local probing-mixture variance is not thermodynamic occupancy. Coverage failure does not refute ensemble effects on translation.
decision: Preserve the closed outcome gate; recover adequate structural information before a newly recorded design.

claim: The folding-derived connectivity hypothesis lacks a completed independent biological validation cohort.
support: The FoldAtlas structure/probing export was not recovered. Original PAIR-MaP was already examined in discovery. Context and engine extensions are sensitivity analyses; accessible reporter phenotypes answer different questions. The PERSIST transfer test is completed but fails, and its scattered constructs do not form complete mutational paths.
strongest_challenge: Reusing inspected sources, overlapping windows or related sequence material as validation would exaggerate independence.
remaining_limitation: A specific missing authenticated structure/probing archive is a source gap, not proof that suitable data do not exist. RNA abundance is not direct structural occupancy or organismal function.
decision: Bound the biology claims and identify each incomplete branch rather than presenting it as a negative experiment.

claim: Projection and path certificates bound interacting product barriers, with exact improvement and failure examples and a sparse hardness boundary.
support: Reviewed proof and independent finite checks; the P3 x K2 example certifies barrier two where the range-only interval is zero to three. A sparse switch reduces cubic MaxCut to exact capacity.
strongest_challenge: Projection bounds and bucket elimination are known; singleton envelopes can miss interactions entirely.
remaining_limitation: Actual elimination-order width, explicit envelope storage and witness output costs remain. No general sparse polynomial algorithm or approximation-hardness claim.
decision: Retain the specialized certificate, counterexamples and exact reduction; no generic novelty claim.

claim: Normalized Gill interaction residuals reproduce weakly across the fixed library comparison.
support: 1,052 validation groups, 18,310 genotypes: cosine 0.077876 versus target 0.5; residual-prediction MSE is 47.73% higher than zero. All three pseudocounts and all 154 omissions fail. Independent replay agrees on 3,352,385 checks.
strongest_challenge: High marginal count-field agreement does not imply normalized residual agreement; a simple cancellation construction demonstrates the logical gap.
remaining_limitation: One related reporter system, shared libraries, unresolved biological preparations, historical coverage selection and nonlinear response alternatives.
decision: Preserve failure and all controls. No biological noise ceiling, causal interaction or independent-gene validation claim.

claim: One modeled ensemble feature does not meet its incremental prediction target in the selected PERSIST cohort.
support: All 37 constructs retained; 22 development and 15 validation. Primary MAE 0.031442 versus composition 0.030139, 4.32% worse. Gain over the matched codon comparator is 0.119%. All 15 omissions retain failure; independent numerical reconstruction agrees.
strongest_challenge: Strong sequence baselines and family-aware splitting remove an apparent advantage from merely adding a folding feature.
remaining_limitation: One selected reporter context within one study; processing selection, unresolved preparation identity and physical endpoint calibration. MUP is calculated and constructs do not form complete paths.
decision: Retain failure, no retuning or favorable subset. Do not generalize to all folding features or claim biological rescue.

claim: Observation prices and optional batches can change exact optimal query cost on the declared six-bit model.
support: All 384 fixed cases retained; batches improve 184 of 192 paired optima with eight ties. Independently verified 279,936 state values and 98,304 trajectories.
strongest_challenge: Finite Bellman recursion and stochastic Boolean function evaluation are established methods. New cost tables do not repair the earlier failed acquisition comparison.
remaining_limitation: Fixed graph, abstract costs and full-support product priors in the experiment. Generic correlated-prior extension needs positive-mass histories and logically universal certificates.
decision: Retain as bounded exact comparison, not a new general algorithm or measured assay efficiency.

status: Closed or gated source branches; not negative biological findings
claim: PAXT, additional splicing and other proposed sources do not presently support the intended validated endpoint comparison.
support: Eligibility audits retain recovered mappings and identify missing endpoint units, construct identities, coverage or independent-unit metadata before outcome modeling.
strongest_challenge: Public data availability alone does not establish that measurements answer the proposed synonymous-accessibility question.
remaining_limitation: Missing metadata or incompatible endpoints could be resolved by future data recovery; no result is inferred from the missing analysis.
decision: Stop expansion on these sources. Preserve the gap and required next evidence.

status: Failed practical prediction criterion; exploratory after source exposure
claim: CNOT3 association adds only a small increment to the fixed baseline/composition prediction comparison.
support: 1,112 held-out genes; primary MAE 0.339316; gains 0.113113% vs codon and 0.041944% vs amino-acid baseline against a 5% rule. Nine models and all 10,008 prediction/error rows retained. Independent reconstruction: 59,268 checks, 240,144 values, max difference 3.3973e-13.
strongest_challenge: Noisy association, baseline coupling, endpoint error and strong composition baselines can limit incremental prediction; a failed model criterion does not refute CNOT3 function.
remaining_limitation: Source-exposed operational cohort, one study, no calibrated biological uncertainty, unresolved 5,480 versus 5,481 discrepancy.
decision: Retire the examined holdout from tuning. Retain the small gain and practical failure without causal or folding-mechanism inference.

status: Established conditional identification calculation; measured allocation unresolved
claim: Baseline stability, relative lifetime response and pathway-specific decay contribution are distinct.
support: Sharp conditional inequalities and constructive nonidentifiability proof. If r=0 is admissible and background change unrestricted, every pathway component in [0,k0] fits the same positive rates. All 5,416 measured rank comparisons retained, rho 0.826797.
strongest_challenge: Single-exponential kinetics, additive rates and independent nuisance ranges are assumptions; a positive residual-activity lower bound can narrow the full interval.
remaining_limitation: Elementary elimination is not a new general decay theory. No justified biological nuisance bounds or half-life error model were recovered.
decision: Retain conditional bounds and descriptive perturbation effects; do not allocate a molecular pathway rate.

status: Unresolved exact reproduction; operational source diagnosis verified
claim: The deposited CNOT3 table supports an exact operational cohort but does not reproduce the published count.
support: Independent readers recover 5,480 of 7,359 candidates, rather than 5,481; all 1,879 exclusions lack half-life fields. Forty-nine arithmetic failures preserved; ten-significant-digit compatibility is post hoc.
strongest_challenge: The undocumented historical selector and rounding operation cannot be reconstructed uniquely from numerical compatibility.
remaining_limitation: A missing identifier is not proven a typographical error, and the original gate remains failed.
decision: Preserve the original failure and separate the explicitly exploratory operational successor.

status: Descriptive measured finite-graph finding; uncertainty uncalibrated
claim: One reserved joint-function square restriction persists across all twelve deposited-series scenarios and the fixed-low-end empirical-range certificate.
support: Reserved square20/group46 is the sole all-scenario and range-certified case; it is removed by omitting that group. Development square45 is all-scenario but range-inconclusive.
strongest_challenge: Additive antagonism alone can create a joint restriction. Unmeasured genotypes can provide bypasses; the observed component here is the same four-vertex square.
remaining_limitation: Same author-preprocessed library; protein-identity assumptions, shared normalization and uncalibrated biological uncertainty remain. No mechanism or practical benefit established.
decision: Retain a bounded descriptive connection to measured function, not independent biological validation.

status: Failed frozen validation and prediction criteria
claim: The joint-function pilot does not pass its two-arm coverage or continuous prediction requirements.
support: Development12 squares/10 groups; reserved6/6 below10/8. Reserved additive completion fails3 of4 continuous ten-percent comparisons. All group deletions and target dropout retained.
strongest_challenge: Removing group277 repairs four prediction comparisons but leaves only five cases and still fails coverage; selecting that deletion would invalidate the frozen comparison.
remaining_limitation: Information-limited within-library validation does not establish a negative biological mechanism. Both arms are now exposed.
decision: Close this pilot without retuning or pooling arms to rescue its criteria.

status: Established elementary conditional comparator limitation; post-outcome analysis
claim: At endpoint-minimum thresholds, coordinatewise convex completion on an opposite-endpoint square cannot predict a joint-only restriction in exact arithmetic.
support: Direct pass-set containment proof and counterexamples independently checked. Both means remain useful continuous-score comparators; additive completion can represent joint restriction without interactions.
strongest_challenge: This is an elementary convexity consequence, not a new general theorem. Floating arithmetic at exact ties can differ from its exact-real assumptions.
remaining_limitation: Established after outcomes; classification superiority over the two structurally negative means is not strong evidence. Not asserted for general graphs.
decision: Narrow classification claims and retain the unchanged, failed continuous comparisons.

status: Verified computational reconstruction; not biological calibration
claim: Independent core and supplement calculations reproduce the saved joint-function results.
support: Core reconstruction checks336 selected cells and432 scenarios across both arms. Portable supplement replay preserves scientific fields;31 independent adapter guard checks pass. All157 frozen inputs unchanged.
strongest_challenge: Agreement among calculations cannot reconstruct source laboratory processing, prove historical blindness or supply missing preparation covariance.
remaining_limitation: Code review is independent implementation with inherited project context, not blinded external replication.
decision: Report computational correctness separately from measurement validity.

claim: The complete FAS native-protein class cannot fit any common nondecreasing response of codon-additive scores inside the primary envelopes.
support: 72 finite vertices; 74 forced orders; five exact differences with weight1/5 cancel. Minimum selected-witness separation1.36%.
strongest_challenge: Variant-dependent RNA abundance or recovery can create the same ordering. Source already reports synonymous interactions.
remaining_limitation: Descriptive empirical ranges; one source/library; no calibrated uncertainty or independent-study validation.
decision: Retain exact conditional exclusion; calculate full-system sensitivity separately as exploratory.

claim: No pair has a nonempty primary restriction interval in the full72-state graph.
support: 204 edges; all2556 endpoint pairs; zero unknown states; point73 and individual scenarios62to307 barrier pairs.
strongest_challenge: Cartesian envelopes combine extrema not observed together.
remaining_limitation: Zero certificate does not prove true connectivity; global model exclusion does not attribute point barriers to interactions.
decision: Preserve zero primary count; assess joint-scenario quantifiers only in a separately frozen exploratory analysis.

claim: Exact count arithmetic and graph/certificate results reproduce independently.
support: 3816 selected-field comparisons;30 rational certificates;74124 pair records; zero discrepancy; offline relocated replay passes.
strongest_challenge: Computational agreement cannot correct genotype-dependent laboratory bias.
remaining_limitation: Format amendment required; corrected source-formula point does not authenticate historical native-reference reproduction.
decision: Retain source failure, all blobs, frozen scientific rules and offline verifier.

claim: Earlier authenticated FAS material does not supply the complete eight-variant inclusion/skipping test.
support: Only5of8 theoretical analyzed-design members; no non-WT witness vertex is a single mutant; direct validations concern selected singles.
strongest_challenge: An undiscovered or separately supplied measurement record could change eligibility.
remaining_limitation: No earlier outcomes or actual measurement coverage opened; same-exon replication would not establish exon generality.
decision: Require sequence-linked per-clone/per-preparation inclusion and skipping plus recovery calibration for all8 targets.

status: Exact conditional global sensitivity boundary; exploratory follow-up
claim: With the native reference fixed at one, the additive-monotone model first becomes feasible at multiplicative envelope factor 1.029715960236 to 1.029715960237.
support: Exact squared factor 9128860950384/8609574801263; additive radius 519286149121/31050521652448. Lower-bound cancellation certificate and feasible boundary field independently verified.
strongest_challenge: This expands descriptive measurement envelopes; it is not measured recovery bias or calibrated uncertainty.
remaining_limitation: One exposed library; classical ordinal-regression robustness is prior. One box-compatible completion is weaker than a correction fitting all preparations.
decision: Retain as the full-system conditional radius, replacing interpretations based on the selected witness margin.

claim: Omitting observation 13 or 42 admits the null; omitting the fixed reference identity 46 also admits it.
support: All 72 observation omissions checked exactly; the other 69 remain infeasible. All 12 preparation omissions and 26 associated boundaries retained.
strongest_challenge: Omitting 46 changes a normalization identity and is not deletion of a third noisy biological sample.
remaining_limitation: Preparation omission narrows the empirical box; it is not independent validation or calibrated influence inference.
decision: Report all omissions without selecting a preferred subset.

claim: No pair is blocked in every observed scenario at a common threshold where both endpoints are retained in every scenario.
support: All 2556 pairs and 27 dependent fields retained; 2475 have one route through their full common endpoint range. 72 have adaptive-only intervals and 22 mixed intervals, with overlap 13.
strongest_challenge: Individual fields and point summaries still have restrictions at their own endpoint thresholds.
remaining_limitation: Finite 72-state graph; no probabilistic statement or unmeasured-detour exclusion. Global null contradiction does not make a particular barrier interaction-dependent.
decision: Preserve zero joint obstruction and keep model exclusion separate from accessibility.

claim: Genotype-dependent recovery or abundance can reproduce one positive enrichment field without varying included fraction.
support: Explicit count-observation factorization and positive nuisance construction; exact 80-case independent checks. Bounded anchored bias is equivalent to the specified one-completion expanded-box test.
strongest_challenge: Independent inclusion/skipping or recovery calibration could constrain the nuisance explanation.
remaining_limitation: Does not assert actual bias, a common correction of all 27 fields, or identifiable splicing kinetics.
decision: Keep measured enrichment as the biological observable; require orthogonal calibrated evidence for mechanistic attribution.

status: Informative null; frozen prediction criterion failed
claim: COMT joint RNA/load prediction does not achieve the declared improvement over all baselines.
support: 125 variants, 53 sites, both source maps and heavy/mid load cases; exact 2,500-prediction reconstruction; 0/53 fixed-prediction site omissions rescues any complete rule.
strongest_challenge: Proxy definitions and shared reference/source dependence differ from physical assay equivalence.
remaining_limitation: Filtering precedes folds; two maps are dependent; original source failure and reference correction remain preserved.
decision: Retain the failed criterion; no retuning or predictive-generalization claim from in-sample fit.

status: Supported recorded-data sensitivity; not calibrated biological uncertainty
claim: Eight of 60 cPRIME profiles retain all three preparation-label dispersions at least twofold under every admissible anonymous-row assignment.
support: 396 paired records; all720 assignments; 60 profiles; exact independent checks.
strongest_challenge: Marker/background dependence and absent full-haplotype/preparation authentication.
remaining_limitation: Does not isolate the intended edit or identify molecular interactions; categories overlap.
decision: Preserve all profiles and exact thresholds; recover matched controls before causal attribution.

status: Verified conditional identification limit; empirical map source-limited
claim: Intended reference identity and retained junction categories do not determine a realized transcript-to-product graph.
support: 6500 reference constructs share239residues; exact positive-mixture and median counterexamples; source operator audit.
strongest_challenge: Actual clone/full-path/product mapping could resolve ambiguity.
remaining_limitation: Conditional examples do not estimate empirical artifact frequency or supply an observed coding graph.
decision: Keep intended regulatory design separate from measured synonymous coding graph membership.

status: Informative null for additional model discrimination; exploratory
claim: The shared-additive and arbitrary shared-order context widening thresholds coincide in all five tested exons.
support: Local matrixrank65/66;140declared nested fits;10 exact boundary witnesses plus cycle lower bounds.
strongest_challenge: Most exon-specific designs are saturated; richer independent designs may discriminate.
remaining_limitation: No untouched context-transfer validation or molecular mechanism.
decision: Retain exact equality including between grid points; do not force an interaction conclusion.

claim: The FAS forced-order system has a unique minimum three-comparison infeasibility support.
support: All74single,2701pair and64824triple supports examined; exact cancellation; persistence agrees with the global boundary.
strongest_challenge: Generic ordinal certificates are prior; recovery or abundance can explain the proxy.
remaining_limitation: Minimum comparison support is not minimum genotype count and establishes no robust accessibility barrier.
decision: Keep global null exclusion, graph restriction and biological mechanism separate.

status: Bounded source audit; no new measured graph
claim: Seven audited source families do not yet supply a newly authenticated complete synonymous neighbourhood beyond the existing FAS class.
support: Source atlas retains intended Schmitz4096states/32768edges and exact unrecovered Schmitz/TP53 records.
strongest_challenge: Additional source files could change eligibility.
remaining_limitation: Not an exhaustive literature census or evidence that suitable data do not exist.

claim: The specified positive equilibrium model has51minimal sufficient observation triples and805sufficient subsets among1024.
support: Global inverses and positive ambiguity maps; all219insufficient subsets covered;2497independent exact checks.
strongest_challenge: Unknown gains, inconsistent populations, zero-rate boundaries or residence time invalidate simple identification.
remaining_limitation: Elementary positive-model classification, not novel general theory; no empirical rates or structure validation.
decision: Use to define the missing measurement contract; do not infer kinetic compensation.

claim: Among the 30 declared intended labels, universal three recorded twofold marker dispersions occur in both cells for two labels, K 562 alone for four, KBM 7 alone for zero and neither for 24.
support: All 396 paired rows,66 local states in two cells,60 profiles,720 assignments and 2160 recorded folds agree with a separately authored exact reconstruction. Eight qualifying profiles occupy six labels across three exons; every profile, exon and omission summary is retained.
strongest_challenge: Original cPRIME work already establishes marker non-neutrality. Persistence of fold dispersion permits marker-order reversal and does not recover preparation pairing.
remaining_limitation: Exposed selected source cohort; no calibrated uncertainty, exon independence, population prevalence, common ordering, isolated intended-edit effect or independent biological validation.
decision: Retain as complete finite concentration/persistence description. Distinguish recorded permutations from continuous interval completion and two-cell persistence from transport validation.

claim: One of 134 within-codon alternative-allele pairs has opposing operational RNA-relative-DNA and oriented low-bin rankings across all 128 declared map/preparation cases.
support: The complete 125-allele 53-site inventory retains 134 pairs at 32 informative sites and 21 singleton sites. All 17152 joint records pass fresh review;133 pairs remain unresolved. The fixed 113-allele 52-site SNV sensitivity retains 97 pairs and the same one reversal. Exact rectangular sensitivity radius is 8361766580791/2251799813685248, with strict persistence only below equality.
strongest_challenge: Hoskins et al. already report cross-layer divergence. Shared-D normalization alone can produce the strict reversal; variant-dependent correction also limits common-reference cancellation.
remaining_limitation: The small deterministic margin is not calibrated assay error. No physical RNA/protein trade-off, compensation, fitness path, native-isoform inference or predictive success is identified.
decision: Retain the complete local finite comparison and normalization counterexample alongside the unchanged failed primary all-baseline prediction criterion.

claim: In the admitted K 562 M/E/C source states, C/M and C/E are strictly below one, and at least twofold lower, throughout every declared Cartesian completion.
support: All 18 approved cells are positive and finite; all 27 state ratios,162 contrast quotients and 729 common-C completions are retained. C/M range is approximately [0.0030312974932514,0.027456511269972]; C/E is approximately [0.0023190311323219,0.020248508790275]. Independent source arithmetic and all 729 joint identities/1458 links pass.
strongest_challenge: The selected example and qualitative marker-removal finding were already published. Pairing envelopes do not cover state-specific recovery, source calibration or transcript visibility.
remaining_limitation: Matched WT RNA response, full haplotypes and culture/clone/harvest joins remain unavailable. No WT-isolated effect, interaction, clinical claim, confidence interval or independent replication.
decision: Retain both conditional-background source contrasts and all null categories. Do not set WT response to one, equate constructed completions to replicates, or elevate the result to new marker-effect discovery.
